tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-horizon gain, while the acquired observations cross negative between H=6.72 and H=13.82 and remain negative at the target horizon. Fit the verified dual-exponential adaptation law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed data exhibit the specified reversal and support the simpler verified dual-exponential mechanism; all measured s_grad values are zero, so a sink coefficient cannot be identified from these rows.
The measured gradual long-horizon reversal is directly explained by the verified adaptation mechanism; a periodic readout is not needed.
The acquired long-horizon observations span the reversal and supply sufficient constraints to fit the four-parameter candidate before fresh confirmation.
